metadata.name: Catalog of NetCDF Files from Dasadhikari et al. 2019 Agricultural Data
metadata.description: A metadata index listing 12 downloadable NetCDF files associated with the Dasadhikari et al. (2019) publication on Pangaea. The catalog includes file names, formats, sizes, and direct download URLs for agricultural data files, likely representing difference analyses between 2010 and 2015 at a 0.1° resolution.
